input.quote: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 imposes a three-year, USD 2,000,000-per-year take-or-pay commitment on us expressly "without reduction or termination rights". That is squarely the playbook's walk-away position: a multi-year take-or-pay with no reduction or exit. It fails the fallback as well, which would require the commitment to be confined to the current twelve-month term, reducible on thirty days' notice, and settled by true-up rather than penalty. There is also no termination-for-convenience right anywhere in Section 9 to relieve the exposure, and Section 2.1 directly contradicts Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges that Customer "has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment." Redline deletes the commitment and confirms Fees are payable only for Services ordered or used (preferred position), with the 12-month reducible commitment offered as a fallback in the comment.

proposal.summary: Remove the three-year USD 2,000,000 take-or-pay commitment; Fees are payable only for Services ordered or used.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a multi-year take-or-pay commitment with no reduction or termination right, and it contradicts Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no minimum-volume commitment. We have replaced it so Fees are payable only for Services actually ordered or used; if a commitment is commercially necessary we could look at one limited to the current twelve-month term, reducible on thirty days' notice and trued up rather than penalised.

ops.oldText: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: 2.1 Customer makes no minimum purchase, volume, or take-or-pay commitment. Customer is obliged to pay only for Services ordered under a signed Order Form or actually used.
